build_model_parallel_transformer_model: build a model parallel transformer model using ModelParallelTransformerModel with megatron vocab parallel embedding
build_model_parallel_encoder: build a ModelParallelTransformerEncoder with configurable encoder layers and optional final layer norm
build_model_parallel_decoder: build a ModelParallelTransformerDecoder with configurable decoder layers and optional cross attention
build_embedding_vocab_parallel: build a VocabParallelEmbedding for model parallel training with dictionary padding and custom initialization
output_layer_projection: project decoder features to vocabulary size using output_layer with model parallel region gathering
